title: Invited Perspective: The Promise of Fit-for-Purpose Systematic Evidence Maps for Supporting Regulatory Health Assessment
excerpt: The scope of an SEM is determined and defined by the Population, Exposure, Comparison, and Outcome (PECO) statement.
